item.title: Youngstown Warren Regional Chamber hosts community event
item.description: The Youngstown Warren Regional Chamber is hosting the Good Morning Campbell Struthers and Lowellville event at the Collingwood Center in Campbell, inviting residents to interact with business leaders and hear about plans for 2026.

item.title: Columbiana County restaurant closing its doors
item.description: The 'Sip Taproom in Lisbon, Ohio is closing its doors on January 31st after much consideration, and will still be open from 4 p.m. - 11 p.m. until then.

item.title: Warren Schools supt. lays out cancellation parameters
item.description: Warren City Schools Superintendent Steve Chiaro outlined the criteria for canceling classes due to weather, including snowfall, wind chill values, road conditions, and power failure, and encouraged families to prepare for the cold temperatures on Thursday and Friday.

item.title: Meeting to discuss Ohio sewer rate increase: PUCO
item.description: The Public Utilities Commission of Ohio (PUCO) will hold a virtual public hearing on Thursday to discuss a potential Aqua Ohio water and sewer rate hike, which could see some consumers' monthly bills rise by up to $300 per year.

item.title: Vallourec announces partnership with energy company
item.description: Vallourec, which has a large pipe-producing plant spanning Youngstown's Northside and Girard, on Wednesday announced a partnership with a company looking to build a geothermal project in the western United States.

item.title: 1 taken to hospital after 2-car crash in Youngstown
item.description: One person was taken to the hospital after a two-car crash in Youngstown on Wednesday evening.

item.title: Boardman Southwoods is first local hospital to offer aquablation prostate surgery
item.description: Southwoods Health in Boardman now has the next-generation technology to help men with enlarged prostates.
